Class QuartzSchedulingProperties

java.lang.Object
com.sca4d.scheduling.quartz.QuartzSchedulingProperties
@ConfigurationProperties("sca4dj.scheduling.quartz") public class QuartzSchedulingProperties extends Object
配置 Quartz 工作线程数和集群节点写入数据库状态的间隔。
